title: Procreate Custom Map Creator Kit
author: PdknyStudio
description:
Custom map creator set: 180+ Unique Brushes for Digital Cartography
The perfect set to create your own personalized map illustrations. Designed specifically for Procreate, these brushes are super user-friendly. No complicated stuff, just dive in and start creating. Mix and match brushes to craft landscapes, mountains, rivers, and cities!
You will receive:
180+ hand drawn Procreate brushes in .brushset format:
• 37 building/city stamp brushes.
• 73 nature/landscape stamps.
• 73 infrastructural stamp brushes.
NOTE! You will need a Procreate app and an iPad to use these Stamp Brushes, they will not work in Photoshop or any other application.
HOW TO INSTALL procreate brushes using the latest iOS update
 • Download file from Creative Fabrica
 • Click on Download Arrow on the top right side of the browser bar
 • Choose the .brushset file from the drop down
 • File will automatically import into Procreate
